summary.text: Jill Duson is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 27 who took office in December 2022 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney by training, she previously served on the Portland, Maine, city council and worked for the Maine Human Rights Commission and the Maine Department of Labor.

paragraphs.text: Jill Duson graduated from Chester High School in 1971, earned a B.A. in political science and literature from Antioch College in 1976, and received a J.D. from the University of Pennsylvania in 1979.

Her career experience includes working as manager of the Compliance Division of the Maine Human Rights Commission, director of the Bureau of Rehabilitation Services of the Maine Department of Labor, and president and principal of Perkins Thompson Consulting, LLC.
Duson has served on the city council of Portland, Maine.

In the Senate she serves on the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee and the Senate Rules Committee for the 2025–2026 session, and she served on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee in 2023–2024.
